primer: Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ: COST) is a top global warehouse club with $303,154M in FY2026 sales. Its 939 clubs, 84.1M paid members, 92.3% U.S./Canada renewal, and 21.23% ROIC earn a clear COMPOUNDER_PASS. Yet at $1,102.15 (53.09x trailing P/E, 43.85x forward P/E, 1.92% FCF yield), shares are priced for perfection. Our Reverse DCF and 39x normalized multiple yield a $990.00 base target, forcing a REJECTED (VALUATION) verdict.
